approval_origin.evidence: User answered 'Sim, prossiga.' to direct question explicitly requesting approval of scientific recommendations S1-S6, including Wholesale Channel and disclosed limitations.
approval_origin.local_unpublished_experiment_history: UNKNOWN_NOT_DECLARED: approval to proceed with exploratory methodology is not a claim of no prior dataset use
approval_origin.source_patient_customer_batch_independen: NOT_VERIFIED; do not infer independence or generalization
approval_origin.historical_public_check: Ten bounded public experimental source sections reviewed; no candidate name reported there, does not establish novelty

selected_datasets.predictive_features: all six original numeric ARFF features in file order
seven original numeric data columns in Raisin_Grains_Dataset worksheet order

excluded_sources.reason: Rice overlaps grain-morphology domain with chosen Raisin; selected for lower prospective runtime not PCC outcome
Website Phishing coded categorical predictors and 48 conflicting class feature patterns; not within continuous Euclidean source protocol

scientific_question: Among originally unlabeled nodes, what fraction changes class argmax between fixed PCC iterations 5000 and 50000 for a fixed graph/label budget/backend, described across three application domains?

preprocessing.population_zscore_rule: For each column j on all source rows, float64 (x_ij - mean(X[:,j])) / std(X[:,j],ddof=0), population denominator n; fail closed on zero variance or nonfinite
preprocessing.wholesale_transform: Require all six spending features finite and >=0; apply float64 log1p elementwise before the same population z-score; no changing after PCC result
preprocessing.versions_and_transformed_array_hashes: P2 technical verification required: exact NumPy implementation, row/column order, native float64 serialization and digest before any fit

graph.PCC_storage: dense int64 neib_list, ordered active entries and -1 padding; int64 neib_qt
graph.installation_route: build_graph, not set_graph; exact native consumer representation and active edges must pass P2 hash equivalence
graph.neighbor_tie_and_order: P2 fail closed on source/neighbor-order drift, no self loops and no empty degrees; test actual graph before any fit
graph.graph_hash: P2 required, not computed in P1

fit.trial_order: registry_index asc, mask_replicate asc, backend_order as above; no outcome-dependent reordering
fit.stop_rule: No early stop, no adaptive resampling, no replacing failed fits
fit.backend_native_RNGs: Native streams differ and are not required to be bitwise identical across backends

rng_and_masks.source_class_encoding: Use exact original class values in sorted lexicographic order; code 0..C-1 for class index; -1 for all unlabeled rows
rng_and_masks.original_row_order: as read from exact pinned source member, no sorting/reordering of observations
rng_and_masks.sampling_recipe: For each class in sorted source label order, get ascending original row indices and call Generator.choice(candidate_indices,size=3,replace=False), once per class per replicate. Sort final selected row indices. The same frozen mask and graph must be used for all three native backends.
rng_and_masks.propagation_seed_recipe: SHA256 ASCII 'pypcc-P1-propagation-v1|uci:<id>|mask:<r>|<backend_name>'; seed=1+(uint32_le(digest[:4]) modulo (2**32-1)); independent from PCG64 mask streams
rng_and_masks.mask_array_hashes: P2 technical preflight required, no mask sampled by P1
rng_and_masks.backend_seed_table: P2 must materialize/verify approved formula before running models

analysis.argmax_tie_rule: first index of exact maximum; count ties at both endpoints; include tied eligible nodes in denominator
analysis.primary_estimator: Count initially-unlabeled nodes with differing argmax between checkpoints / originally unlabeled count
analysis.backend_reporting: Report all 8 mask values and within-dataset/backend mean, median, min, max
analysis.cross_dataset_reporting: For each backend unweighted average of 3 dataset-level mask means
analysis.secondary: Accuracy and balanced accuracy using held-out original labels only in post-fit reporting; report dominance margins and tie counts; never select graph/seed/preprocessing using these results
analysis.missingness: Record failed or noncompleting case in append-only attempt ledger; no silent replacement/drop; if any case missing, withhold unqualified 72-fit summary

ethics_and_limitations.sources_attribution: UCI source and required CC BY 4.0 attribution for all three; verify specific reuse conditions before any source artifact publication
ethics_and_limitations.patients: Clinical-origin tabular features; no verified unique patient or visit IDs and no reidentification attempts
ethics_and_limitations.grains: Image-derived morphology, independent grains/batches not demonstrated
ethics_and_limitations.customers: Customer spending features, company/group identity not demonstrated; derived Channel task differs from UCI's declared target Region
ethics_and_limitations.science_claim: Within the three chosen datasets and disclosed constraints only

approvals_and_execution.authorized_next_phase: P2 no-fit engineering/preflight planning only, with explicit separate approval before any real PCC fit
